text: Pipeline source files for nova keymgr/limit/servicegroup are in New-repo-test; KB records live under .aee/kb/ at repo root; docs go to docs/src/<relative-path>.md

In this pipeline, source files are not checked out in the working tree; analysis relies on KB records (.aee/kb/), pipeline artifacts (candidates.json, coverage.json), and scanner output — direct file reads of src/ will fail.
aee-artifact path <name> only resolves registered artifact names; files in .aee/ present on disk but not in artifacts.jsonl are not reachable by name — read them directly from the filesystem

The security reviewer pipeline uses test-repo issue #3 for keymgr+limit+servicegroup batch coordination; security:analysis-ready signals the reviewer, security:approved wakes cross_file_security_correlator.

In the new-pipeline, the /src source folder is not checked out in the working tree for the license-compliance-analyzer; Trivy license scanning must target the repo root (.) as a fallback when /src does not exist — the scan will return zero findings since no license files are present in the .aee/ artifact tree.

New-repo-test has no dependency manifest files (pom.xml, requirements.txt, package.json, go.mod) on any branch; Nova source is Python-only and not committed as actual files, only as KB records under .aee/kb/.
The New-repo-test repository contains no infrastructure-as-code files (Dockerfiles, Terraform, Kubernetes manifests); infrastructure-analyzer produces empty reports for this repo.

When component synthesis documents already exist on agent_workspace with placeholder overviews but no registered artifacts, the synthesizer should update the Overview sections in-place and register artifacts rather than rewriting the entire document.
The code-quality-analyzer emits the label 'quality:analysis-ready' (created if not present) on test-repo issue #3 after completing analysis of the nova keymgr/limit/servicegroup batch

In the new-pipeline verifier, the Extract Log artifact (.aee/extract-log.jsonl) may exist on disk but not be registered in artifacts.jsonl; register it with aee-artifact add before the readiness gate will pass.

aee-cluster is not installed in the new-pipeline functional-analyzer environment; the available aee tools are: aee-ssh-sign, aee-wait-ci, aee-ask, aee-wake, aee-emit, aee-artifact, aee-toolchain, aee-intake, aee-seams, aee-callflow, aee-link, aee-entry.sh, aee-changed-files, aee-quality-audit, aee-security-audit, aee-synthesize, aee-correlate, aee-link-report, aee-quality-scan, aee-extract, aee-inventory, aee-security-scan.
Link Graph and Extract Log files may exist on disk under .aee/ without being registered as named artifacts in artifacts.jsonl; read them directly by path when aee-artifact path reports missing.

In the new-pipeline quality batch for keymgr/limit/servicegroup, pylint R0913 (too-many-arguments, threshold 5) and lizard params metric (threshold 6) both fire on the same function; only one should be kept as a finding.
